question: Does a manual-enable reference logic prevent automatic restart after power loss or fault while the button is held?
method: Exhaustive abstract state/input transition enumeration plus power-loss and held-button traces; no hardware timing model
stop_condition: Check all 3 states times 32 Boolean input combinations once and specified traces
criteria: Power or monitor invalidity, fault, or stop forces disabled wait-release state
Enable requires button release observed while healthy followed by press
Fault clearance alone never enables output
limits: No contact bounce analog POR metastability or component failure proof
Physical default-low enable circuit and independent protection remain required
